title: Player: real zero gravity
description: player zero gravity simulation, without Y-attachment. Free rotation
body:
**A mod that adds a realistic zero-gravity simulation.** 

Players can move freely in 3D space, build up momentum, push off blocks, and control their orientation without being constrained to world axes.

The mod includes configurable push reach and a simple API for integration with other mods.

This mod is primarily intended as a library for [space engine mod](https://youtu.be/yIFajBDQpWI) mod and other mods, and has limited functionality on its own. However, you can test it using the command /spaceGravity <mode> <player>, where <mode> is either 0 or 1. (preferably with zero or low gravity dimension)
